review_scope: Source-bound project watcher, sandbox browser and actual scanner assertions

declarations.parity_review: Reviewed ignores the generated trees that can exhaust the watch table. Five watcher declarations preserve generated-tree exclusions, default and custom subscription arguments, native callback Function semantics, ENOSPC translation and unrelated errors. The sandbox browser declaration preserves readiness fetch Object options and exact noVNC result fields. Raw call guards accept genuine functions only at Function asymmetric positions, and reject custom serialization/accessors. Eight controls reject changed expectations, constructor inputs, hybrid operands, matcher patterns, fabricated observations, shadowed Function and weakened reset lifecycle. Every import, setup, lifecycle and reachable assertion operand is bound by the AST comparison. Actual Vitest and Rust matcher agree for all observations and opposing counterexamples. Stable full translated, internal, managed, Docker, Chromium and scanner lanes pass. Evidence: .jait/artifacts/parity-100-current/source-checkpoint/.jait/artifacts/parity-100-stable-typed/combined-selected.json, wire-summary.json and structural-negative-controls.json. All original, peer, transport, matcher and review-helper fingerprints still match the live checkout. This credits reference-test assertion preservation only; native gateway runtime coverage is separate.
